instruction: Fix `partition` so elements equal to the pivot are included in the left partition (they are currently dropped).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops.py b/seqops.py
--- a/seqops.py
+++ b/seqops.py
@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@
 
 def partition(seq, pivot):
     """Return (left, right) where left <= pivot < right."""
-    left = [x for x in seq if x < pivot]
+    left = [x for x in seq if x <= pivot]
     right = [x for x in seq if x > pivot]
     return left, right
